SBI Debit Card Loyalty Program:
FreedomRewardz
SBI Premium earns 1 FreedomRewardz point (Reward point) for every Rs. 200/- you shop, dine out, fill fuel, book travel or spend online.
Earn Bonus points on the first three purchase transactions using your SBI Premium as under:
50 Bonus FreedomRewardz points on first purchase transaction within completion of one calendar month of issuance.
50 additional Bonus FreedomRewardz points on second purchase transaction within completion of one calendar month of issuance.
100 additional Bonus FreedomRewardz points on third purchase transaction within completion of one calendar month of issuance.
Continue using your SBI Premium for at least 3 purchase transactions in a quarter and triple your points earned for the quarter!
These FreedomRewardz Points earned can be accumulated and redeemed for exciting gifts. Please visit
SBI Rewardz
for more information.
Complimentary Insurance
The SBI Premium Debit Card (MasterCard/Visa) comes with complimentary Insurance Covers as given below:
Cover
Details
Cover Amount
Personal Accident Insurance (Death)- Non-Air
Cover available to Debit Cards which are active on any channel, viz, PoS/e-Com/ATM, during the last 90 days from the date of accident.
Rs.5,00,000/-
Personal Air Accidental Insurance (Death)
Cover available to Debit Cards which are active on any channel, viz, PoS/e-Com/ATM, during the last 90 days from the date of accident, subject to a condition of the air ticket being purchased using the Debit Card.
Rs.10,00,000/-
Family Transportation & Transportation of Mortal Remains
If the Personal Accident Insurance claim is accepted as a valid claim, then the expenses incurred in transporting 2 immediate family members to the hospital, and the expenses incurred in transporting the mortal remains of the insured person from hospital to the residence, will be reimbursed as an additional benefit.
Upto Rs.50,000/-
Checked-in Baggage Loss Cover
Checked-in Baggage Loss Cover (in addition to the Cover available from the airline company) for lost baggage during air travel (Domestic & International) subject to a condition of the air ticket being purchased using the Debit Card.
Upto Rs.25,000/-
Purchase Protection Cover
Purchase Protection for theft and burglary upto 90 days from the date of purchase in respect of items purchased using Debit Card at PoS/e-Com
Rs.50,000/-
Lost Card Liability Cover
Cover available on Unauthorized use of Lost/Stolen Debit Card. 2 days pre reporting and 7 day post reporting (including the reporting day) claims are covered. Pin/OTP based transactions not covered.
Rs.2,00,000/

Airport Lounge Access on SBI Premium Debit Card
SBI Premium Debit Cards are one of the select variants of the Cards having complimentary airport lounge access. The terms & conditions of these facilities are governed by the respective Card networks (Visa/MasterCard). For further details, please visit respective Card network’s website.
